name: CMAT
conductingBody: Pokhara University (PU) on behalf of Management faculties
about: CMAT (Common Management Admission Test) is a national-level entrance exam for admission to MBS (Master of Business Studies), MBA, and related management programs at Tribhuvan University, Pokhara University, and affiliated colleges across Nepal. It tests quantitative, verbal, analytical, and general management skills.

eligibility.qualification: Bachelor's Degree (any discipline) from a recognized university
eligibility.workExperience: Not required for MBS; some MBA programs require 2+ years of work experience

admissionPrograms: MBA (Master of Business Administration) — various colleges

subjects.name: Verbal Ability
subjects.description: Tests language skills, reading comprehension, grammar, and vocabulary

chapters.name: Reading Comprehension
chapters.examTip: Read the questions before the passage to know what to look for.

chapters.name: Grammar and Usage
chapters.examTip: Eliminate answer choices that change the meaning of the sentence.

chapters.name: Vocabulary
chapters.examTip: Build a daily vocabulary of 10 new words during preparation.

chapters.name: Verbal Reasoning
chapters.examTip: For para jumbles, identify the opening and closing sentences first.

subjects.name: Quantitative Ability
subjects.description: Tests mathematical and analytical reasoning skills

chapters.name: Arithmetic
chapters.examTip: Profit/Loss and SI/CI questions use standard formulas — memorize them.

chapters.name: Algebra
chapters.examTip: For word problems, define variables clearly before writing equations.

chapters.name: Data Interpretation
chapters.examTip: Approximate values quickly — exact calculation wastes time in DI questions.

chapters.name: Geometry and Mensuration
chapters.examTip: Know formulas for all common shapes — tested with diagrams.

subjects.name: Logical Reasoning
subjects.description: Tests analytical and logical reasoning ability

chapters.name: Analytical Reasoning
chapters.examTip: Draw diagrams for seating arrangement problems — never attempt mentally.

chapters.name: Logical Patterns
chapters.examTip: Check differences, ratios, and alternating terms when identifying series.

chapters.name: Critical Reasoning
chapters.examTip: Critical reasoning answers must be based ONLY on the passage — no personal knowledge.

subjects.name: General Awareness
subjects.description: Tests knowledge of business, economy, current affairs, and general management concepts

chapters.name: Business and Economy
chapters.examTip: Read The Himalayan Times business section weekly during preparation.

chapters.name: Current Affairs — Nepal and World
chapters.examTip: Follow Gorkhapatra or Ratopati daily. Focus on news from the last 6 months.

chapters.name: Basic Management Concepts
chapters.examTip: Know the '4 functions of management' and 'SWOT analysis' — classic CMAT questions.

recommendedBooks: Word Power Made Easy — Norman Lewis
preparationStrategy.dailyPlan: 2 hours/day: 45 min Verbal + 45 min Quant + 30 min Current Affairs
preparationStrategy.mockTests: Solve 2 full-length mock tests per week in the last month
